Package picocli

Class AutoComplete

java.lang.Object
picocli.AutoComplete
public class AutoComplete extends Object
Stand-alone tool that generates bash auto-complete scripts for picocli-based command line applications.

  • Method Details

    • main

      public static void main(String... args)
      Generates a bash/zsh, fish or PowerShell completion script for the specified command class.
      Parameters:
      args - command line options. Specify at least the commandLineFQCN mandatory parameter, which is the fully qualified class name of the annotated @Command class to generate a completion script for. Other parameters are optional. Specify -h to see details on the available options.

    • bash

      public static void bash(String scriptName, File out, File command, CommandLine commandLine) throws IOException
      Generates source code for an autocompletion bash script for the specified picocli-based application, and writes this script to the specified out file, and optionally writes an invocation script to the specified command file.
      Parameters:
      scriptName - the name of the command to generate a bash autocompletion script for
      commandLine - the CommandLine instance for the command line application
      out - the file to write the autocompletion bash script source code to
      command - the file to write a helper script to that invokes the command, or null if no helper script file should be written
      Throws:
      IOException - if a problem occurred writing to the specified files

    • fish

      public static String fish(String scriptName, CommandLine commandLine)
      Generates and returns the source code for a fish completion script for the specified picocli-based application.

      Fish's complete builtin is declarative: unlike bash, this generates a shell function only to tell the position of a positional parameter, and only if needed. Each option, positional parameter and subcommand becomes its own complete -c line, scoped to the right place in the command hierarchy with -n conditions built around fish's __fish_seen_subcommand_from helper function.

      Parameters:
      scriptName - the name of the command to generate a fish completion script for
      commandLine - the CommandLine instance for the command line application
      Returns:
      source code for a fish completion script
      Since:
      4.8

    • powershell

      public static String powershell(String scriptName, CommandLine commandLine)
      Generates and returns the source code for a PowerShell completion script for the specified picocli-based application.

      The script registers a native argument completer (Register-ArgumentCompleter -Native) that works in Windows PowerShell 5.1 as well as in PowerShell 7+. It contains the command hierarchy as data, followed by a small generic function that walks the words typed so far down that data and offers the subcommands, options (including negated names of negatable options), enum constants and other completion candidates that apply at the cursor, with the descriptions as tooltips. Where nothing is known to complete, PowerShell's default file name completion applies. The script contains only ASCII characters.

      Parameters:
      scriptName - the name of the command to generate a PowerShell completion script for
      commandLine - the CommandLine instance for the command line application
      Returns:
      source code for a PowerShell completion script
      Since:
      4.7.7.1
